notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Composite Golem.
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Composite Golem dies, triggering Adarkar Valkyrie, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Composite Golem enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
